verdict.rationale: Jules is itself an autonomous coding agent to which users delegate tasks (via label, web app, or API), which plans, executes in a VM, and returns a PR for review — strongly documented end-to-end (jules-docs-2,4,6,7,8) and corroborated by users who report offloading real work and getting usable PRs (jules-comm-6,11,12,16). However, multiple hands-on reports describe reliability caveats — getting stuck in loops with no stop button, needing heavy babysitting, and struggling on complex/monorepo tasks (jules-comm-9,13,15,18) — so delegation works but with significant real-world friction. Missing for 10: independent benchmark of task success rate and resolution of the loop/stuck-task reliability issue reported by users.
